title: HSBC UK named UK ‘Bank of the Year’ by The Banker for the second year in a row - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: HSBC UK has been named UK ‘Bank of the Year’ for 2024 in the Banker’s Bank of the Year Awards.

headings.text: HSBC UK named UK ‘Bank of the Year’ by The Banker for the second year in a row

The award recognises the Bank’s strategy for putting customers first and finding new ways to support people and businesses at every age and every stage – from helping its Global Money customers save more than £10m in FX fees and facilitating more than £4.5bn of sustainable finance, to deepening its charitable partnerships with organisations like Shelter and the Scouts and reaching 645,000 young people with financial education.
Ian Stuart, CEO, HSBC UK, said:
"I’m honoured that HSBC UK has been named The Banker’s UK Bank of the Year for the second year in a row.

"It’s been another fantastic year of supporting the financial health of our customers and the wider communities we serve. We focused on our strengths – leveraging our international reach to deliver for our personal and business customers at home and abroad, while also keeping focus on sustainability and doubling down on innovation.

"By focusing on these priorities, we delivered one of our best financial years in FY23 and have continued this momentum and growth through 2024. Looking ahead, we will remain focused on capturing opportunities for growth as the external environment and economic conditions change for customers.
"Huge thank you to all our customers and the colleagues that support them. When our customers succeed, so do we."
The Banker has been at the forefront of international banking coverage since 1926 and the Bank of the Year Awards are regarded as the industry standard for banking excellence.
The competing institutions are judged on their ability to deliver strong financial performance while turning challenges into opportunities in an ever-evolving business environment.

HSBC UK serves over 14.9 million active customers across the UK, supported by 23,700 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates. HSBC UK is a ring-fenced bank and wholly-owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc. HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 60 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,099bn at 30 September 2024, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
